blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Central Abbotsford fell from 73 in June to 70 in September (−4.1%), and 27 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 15.9% of Abbotsford’s 440 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Central Abbotsford?
Central Abbotsford also had 256 condos and townhomes listed and 35 sold in September, against 70 houses listed. The Central Abbotsford condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Central Abbotsford?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 70 houses listed in Central Abbotsford. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central Abbotsford a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Central Abbotsford had a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Central Abbotsford from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 27 houses sold in Central Abbotsford over those 4 months, out of 215 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Central Abbotsford?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
